theater: 西奈半島與蘇伊士運河走廊

battle.name: 第二次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 西奈半島與蘇伊士運河走廊
battle.brief: 一九五六年十月二十九日以軍突襲西奈，三十一日英法聯軍自塞浦路斯與馬耳他起飛空襲埃及。卡面這件AMX-13輕型坦克是法國一九五三年才列裝的新裝備，隨法軍突擊部隊配屬運河區，擔任武裝偵察與前沿警戒。十一月五日英法空降塞得港，七日蘇伊士陷落，停火時以軍佔領西奈至拉法一線。

kit.name: AMX-13輕型坦克
kit.history: 1953年列裝法軍，1956年配屬於投入蘇伊士運河區的法國裝甲單位。

countries: 交戰方是三方聯盟對一個主權國。埃及方面由總統迦梅爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾掌握最高決策，軍隊總指揮為元帥阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾，參謀長為阿卜杜勒·哈菲茲·穆罕默德；作戰序列以西奈方面軍為主，第四裝甲師、第三步兵師、第七步兵師等單位沿運河兩側與西奈邊境展開，首都與三角洲由預備隊及空降兵力守護，埃及陸軍沿襲英軍式的編制與英式裝備，捷克斯洛伐克與蘇聯交付的坦克與噴氣戰鬥機在一九五六年秋天才剛到貨，還未完成整建。以色列方面由總理大衛·班·古里安坐鎮特拉維夫，國防軍參謀長摩西·達揚主持作戰，總參謀部由摩西·馬克萊夫中將負責全軍體制；野戰部隊以裝甲師、步兵師與第二〇二傘兵旅為主幹，戰前已完成全面動員，空軍由莫爾代凱·霍德指揮，裝備「神秘四型」噴氣戰鬥機與各型螺旋槳攻擊機。英法聯合部隊方面，英國由首相安東尼·艾登與國防大臣鄧肯·桑迪斯拍板，參謀總長傑拉爾德·坦普勒與中東陸軍司令查爾斯·開特利策劃行動，皇家海軍東地中海艦隊自馬耳他與塞浦路斯出航，皇家空軍中東部隊自塞浦路斯起飛；法國由總理居伊·莫勒、外長埃德加·福爾主導，參謀總長保羅·埃利與作戰參謀長安德烈·博福特制訂計畫，投入傘兵營、突擊團與裝甲部隊，行動代號「音樂家」；十月二十四日在巴黎近郊塞弗爾簽訂的三方秘密協定，規定由以色列先攻西奈，英法再以「維護自由航行」為名出兵接管運河區。
countriesEn: The belligerents were a three-sided coalition against a single sovereign state. On the Egyptian side the supreme decisions were taken by President Gamal Abdel Nasser; the field command in Sinai belonged to Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer, with the chief of staff role held by Abdel Hafez Ahmed. The order of battle was the Western Asiatic theatre: the 4th Armoured Division, the 3rd Infantry Division and the 7th Infantry Division were spread along the bank of the canal and the Sinai frontier, while the capital and the Nile Delta were watched by reserves and airborne troops. The Egyptian army, built up under British sponsorship, still ran on British organisation and British-pattern equipment; the Czech-built tanks and Soviet-built jet fighters only began to arrive in the autumn of 1956 and were not yet fully formed up. Israel was directed from Tel Aviv by Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion, with the national defence forces run operationally by Chief of Staff Moshe Dayan and the general staff under Major General Mordechai Maklef. The field army centred on an armoured division, infantry divisions and the 202nd Parachute Brigade, and mobilisation had been completed before the fighting began; the air force, commanded by Mordechai Hod, fielded Mystère IV jet fighters alongside a range of propeller-driven attack aircraft. The Anglo-French force was decided in London by Prime Minister Anthony Eden and Defence Secretary Duncan Sandys, with the plan drawn up by Chief of the Imperial General Staff Gerald Templer and by the Middle East Land Forces commander Charles Keightley; the Royal Navy's Eastern Mediterranean fleet sailed from Malta and Cyprus and the RAF Middle East command flew out of Cyprus. France acted under Prime Minister Guy Mollet and Foreign Minister Edgar Faure, with Chief of Staff Paul Ely and operations chief André Beaufre shaping the plan, code-named Operation Musketeer, and airborne battalions, commandos and armour committed under it. The tripartite secret agreement signed at Sèvres outside Paris on 24 October provided that Israel would strike first in Sinai and that Britain and France would then enter under the pretext of protecting the freedom of navigation.
people: 關鍵人物分屬四邊。埃及總統迦梅爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾是整場危機的樞紐：他不接受英法兩國要求以軍先行後撤的最後通牒，寧可讓埃軍在西奈多線苦戰，也不肯在主權問題上退讓；西奈方面軍指揮官阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾元帥與參謀長阿卜杜勒·哈菲茲·穆罕默德在戰線上決定撤退與反擊的節奏。以色列方面，總參謀長摩西·達揚是整個「卡德什」作戰的設計者：他把第二〇二傘兵旅派往米特拉山口實施縱深空降，營長阿里·沙龍率部衝上山口頂點，正是這支部隊把埃及第四裝甲師與預備隊吸在內陸，總理大衛·班·古里安與參謀長摩西·馬克萊夫之間在是否參戰、如何分擔盟國義務上屢有爭執。英法方面，英國首相艾登在內閣與外交部的強烈反對下仍批准出兵，參謀總長坦普勒主張以有限兵力迅速奪取運河；法國由總理莫勒、外長福爾、參謀總長埃利與作戰參謀長博福特共同推動，地面作戰在西奈與運河一線的指揮落到海軍陸戰隊突擊旅與法軍傘兵營手上，其後在塞得港的法軍指揮官馬蘇中將，是最熟悉該地區的法國將領。外交戰線上，美國總統艾森豪威爾以停止對英石油供應為槓桿，蘇聯部長會議主席赫魯曉夫向巴黎與倫敦發出最後通牒，聯合國秘書長拉爾夫·邦奇與加拿大外長萊斯特·皮爾森在日內瓦推動停火與聯合國部隊的部署。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sat on four different sides. Egyptian President Gamal Abdel Nasser was the pivot of the whole crisis: he refused the Anglo-French ultimatum demanding an Israeli withdrawal and preferred to see his army fight hard along several axes in Sinai rather than give way on the question of sovereignty. The commander in Sinai, Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer, and the chief of staff Abdel Hafez Ahmed, set the tempo of withdrawal and counter-attack on the front. On the Israeli side Chief of Staff Moshe Dayan designed the entire Operation Kadesh: he sent the 202nd Parachute Brigade into Mitla Pass for a vertical landing deep behind the Egyptian line, and battalion commander Ariel Sharon led his men onto the summit; it was that formation which pinned the Egyptian 4th Armoured Division and the reserves inland, while Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion and Chief of the General Staff Mordechai Maklef argued repeatedly over whether to fight at all and over how the burden of the alliance would be shared. In London Anthony Eden approved the intervention over the strong objections of his cabinet and the Foreign Office, and the Chief of the Imperial General Staff, Gerald Templer, argued for a small force moving fast to seize the canal. In France the policy was driven by Guy Mollet, Edgar Faure, Paul Ely and André Beaufre, and the ground war in Sinai and along the canal fell to the marine commandos and the French airborne battalions; the French commander at Port Said, General Massu, was the officer who knew that ground best. On the diplomatic front President Eisenhower used the threat of cutting off oil to Britain as his lever, Khrushchev sent a last warning to Paris and London, and at Geneva Ralph Bunche and Lester Pearson worked towards a ceasefire and the deployment of a United Nations force.
kits: 卡面這件AMX-13輕型坦克是一九五三年才量產的法國裝備，在一九五六年十月的蘇伊士運河區是聯軍序列中最新、也最陌生的主戰裝備之一。它重約十三噸，乘員二人，採扭桿懸吊，車體極低，裝有一門七十五毫米戰鬥車砲，砲塔內有半自動裝填機構，備彈四十七發，可三發連發，最大時速約七十公里；這種設計明顯是針對歐洲本土的核戰爭與狹窄街道而來，並非為在開闊沙灘上與敵國裝甲師傾力對決而造。因此它在運河區的任務是偵察、警戒、掩護傘兵與突擊隊，以及在城鎮街道中充當快速反應的火力點，而不是與埃及的裝甲師正面爭鋒。與它同行的法軍裝甲還有M47「巴頓」式坦克與各型裝甲車、卡車；英軍側是自歐洲調來的百夫長坦克、彗星巡洋坦克、裝甲車與「薩拉丁」輪式偵察車；英法砲兵使用二十五磅野戰砲與一〇五毫米榴彈砲。以色列陸軍的坦克以M3、M4「謝爾曼」與M26「潘興」為主，傘兵旅靠半履帶車、吉普車與輕型車輛輸送，空軍有「神秘四型」與「暴風雨」機。埃及則在英制M-84「酋長」坦克、捷克斯洛伐克製T-34-85與蘇聯製MiG-15、MiG-17之間換代，這套裝備的混雜本身就是這場危機的寫照。
kitsEn: The AMX-13 light tank on the card face was a French design that only reached quantity production in 1953, and in the Suez canal zone in October 1956 it was among the newest and least familiar major weapons in the coalition order of battle. It weighed about thirteen tonnes, carried a crew of two, used torsion bar suspension and an extremely low hull, and mounted a 75mm tank gun with a semi-automatic loader holding forty-seven rounds capable of three-round bursts, at a maximum speed of roughly seventy kilometres per hour. The design was plainly made for nuclear war in Europe and for cramped streets, not for a full-weight engagement with an enemy armoured division across open sand. Its tasks in the canal zone were therefore reconnaissance, security work, the covering of paratroopers and commandos, and the provision of a fast-reaction firepower base inside towns, rather than a set-piece tank duel with the Egyptian armoured divisions. Alongside it the French brought M47 Patton tanks, armoured cars and trucks; the British brought Centurion and Comet tanks, armoured cars and the Saladin wheeled reconnaissance vehicle, with 25-pounder field guns and 105mm howitzers in support. The Israeli army fielded M3, M4 Sherman and M26 Pershing tanks, with half-tracks, jeeps and light vehicles carrying the parachute brigade, and operated Mystère IV and Ouragan aircraft. Egypt meanwhile was changing over between British M-84 Chieftains, Czech-built T-34-85s and Soviet MiG-15 and MiG-17 fighters; the mixture of equipment in Egyptian hands is itself a portrait of the crisis.
tactics: 三方在戰術層面的做法完全不同。以色列執行「卡德什」作戰，核心是縱深空降配合正面突破：十月二十九日以軍先以空軍掃蕩埃及各處機場，再由第二〇二傘兵旅在米特拉山口實施當日黃昏的垂直降落，數千名傘兵奪取山口兩側要點，把埃及第四裝甲師與預備隊吸在內陸；與此同時以軍裝甲師沿海岸公路向北推進，兵分多路夜襲阿布奧格拉等要點，切斷埃軍後方縱深，再以工兵連續爆破清障，把裝甲部隊從沙丘後方一段一段拉上來。英法的「音樂家」計畫則是典型的海空協同：十月二十九日英法艦隊在塞得港外海以艦砲射擊埃軍岸防陣地，十月三十一日兩百餘架戰機自塞浦路斯與馬耳他起飛，分波次摧毀埃及空軍在地面的大批作戰機與多個前線機場，同時壓制地中海上空的埃及起降；十一月五日英軍第三空降旅一千餘人降落塞得港機場，第四十二與第四十皇家海軍陸戰隊突擊旅合計約二千二百人自福阿德港與塞得港外灘登陸，奪取運河北端橋頭，法軍第二外籍傘兵營與突擊團隨後投入，兵鋒沿運河南下。埃及的戰術是節節抵抗加上伏擊：裝甲師依托沙丘與村落做梯次據守，步兵在殘垣後層層反擊，以火箭筒與反戰車砲伏擊英法縱隊；空軍雖遭重創，仍以米格機在高空襲擊英法低空航行與輸送的船團；撤退時則在運河航道上沉船阻塞，據當時影像與各方記載，至十一月中旬已有二十一艘船被沉入航道，令聯軍的補給線屢受牽制。
tacticsEn: The three sides fought at the tactical level in three entirely different ways. Israel ran Operation Kadesh as a combination of vertical envelopment and deliberate breakthrough: on 29 October the air force swept the Egyptian airfields, and the 202nd Parachute Brigade made its vertical landing at Mitla Pass at dusk, several thousand men seizing the ground on either side of the pass and pinning the Egyptian 4th Armoured Division and the reserves inland. At the same time the Israeli armoured division drove north along the coastal road in dispersed columns, attacking points such as Abu-Ageila at night to cut the Egyptian rear, with engineers clearing and demolishing obstacles in front of the armour so that it could be dragged up out of the sand hollows one stretch at a time. The Anglo-French plan, Operation Musketeer, was classic sea-air coordination: on 29 October the combined fleet shelled the Egyptian shore positions outside Port Said, and on 31 October more than two hundred aircraft took off from Cyprus and Malta, hitting the Egyptian air force on the ground in successive waves and destroying a large part of its operational strength and several forward airfields. On 5 November the British 3rd Parachute Brigade, more than a thousand men, dropped onto the Port Said airfield, while the 42nd and 40th Royal Marine commandos, about 2,200 men in all, landed from the beaches at Port Fouad and Port Said and seized the bridgehead at the northern end of the canal; the French 2nd Foreign Parachute Battalion and commando units went in afterwards, driving south along the canal. Egypt fought a war of delaying action and ambush: armoured divisions held in successive echelon behind dunes and villages, infantry counter-attacked from shattered walls, and rocket launchers and anti-tank guns ambushed the columns of the coalition. Its air force, though gutted, still attacked shipping and supply convoys in the Mediterranean from altitude with MiGs. On the way out it scuttled ships in the canal; contemporary film and the accounts of the time record twenty-one vessels sunk into the channel by mid-November, hampering the coalition supply line.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，但各方史料互相矛盾，只能取其量級。以色列投入的野戰部隊一般記為三個師級單位、總兵力約四萬人；埃及方面在西奈與運河沿線的部隊常被記為五萬至六萬人，其中第四裝甲師是預備隊的骨幹；英法首批投入的空降與登陸兵力約三千至五千人，其中英國第三空降旅一千餘人，第四十二與第四十突擊旅合計約二千二百人，法軍投入數個傘兵營與突擊團。空海火力方面，英法調動飛機逾二百架、艦艇逾一百艘，飛機數量之大，連一處已失去保養的機場都被臨時啟用。埃及空軍在十月三十一日首波空襲中損失慘重，絕大部分作戰機在地面被毀或被迫封存，少數起飛的米格在空戰中與英法制空部隊交手，損失數十架。地面戰最激烈的三天裏，以軍陣亡數百人、負傷逾千，聯軍方面陣亡亦有數百人，埃及被俘官兵以數千計，具體數字各方統計相差甚遠。停火時序則相當明確：十一月六日英法接受停火，七日埃及停火，八日以軍同意撤出；英軍到十二月下旬完成撤離運河區，法軍遲至一九五七年一月才全部退出，以軍則於一九五七年三月撤出西奈與加沙。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows, though the sources contradict one another and only the order of magnitude can be relied on. The Israeli field force is usually given as three division-sized formations totalling about forty thousand men; the Egyptian troops in Sinai and along the canal are commonly put at fifty to sixty thousand, with the 4th Armoured Division forming the core of the reserve; the first Anglo-French airborne and amphibious echelon numbered perhaps three to five thousand men, of whom the British 3rd Parachute Brigade was more than a thousand and the 42nd and 40th commandos together about 2,200, alongside several French airborne battalions and commando groups. On the air and sea side the coalition brought to bear more than two hundred aircraft and more than a hundred warships; there were so many aircraft that a disused airfield with no maintenance was pressed back into service. The Egyptian air force was badly mauled in the opening strike on 31 October: the great majority of its operational aircraft were destroyed on the ground or had to be stored, and the few MiGs that did get airborne met the coalition air defence in the resulting dogfights, losing dozens of machines. In the three heaviest days of the ground fighting the Israelis lost several hundred dead and more than a thousand wounded, the coalition counted several hundred dead as well, and Egyptian personnel taken prisoner ran into the thousands, with the exact totals differing widely between accounts. The ceasefire sequence, by contrast, is clear: the British and French accepted a ceasefire on 6 November, Egypt ceased fire on the 7th, Israel agreed to withdraw on the 8th. British forces were out of the canal zone by late December, the French did not complete their withdrawal until January 1957, and the Israelis did not leave Sinai and Gaza until March 1957.
cause: 起因有三層。最直接的一層是運河主權：一九五六年七月二十六日，納賽爾宣布將蘇伊士運河收歸國有，以通行費收入興建阿斯旺水壩；運河公司股份英法合佔逾九成，形式上卻註冊為埃及公司，此舉等於在埃及土上沒收英法近半的產業資產，兩國輿論立即沸騰。深一層是軍備與援助：埃及軍方在西方拒絕出售新式武器之後，轉向捷克斯洛伐克與蘇聯洽購MiG-15、MiG-17與坦克，蘇聯答應供應；美國隨即在七月十九日宣布停止援助興建阿斯旺水壩以示懲罰，歐洲國家擔心自身在中東的軍政體系會被這一連串動作蠶食。第三層是海峽與航道：埃及封閉蒂朗海峽，切斷以色列經紅海通往亞喀巴灣的出口，以色列視之為勒頸的絞索；納賽爾的泛阿拉伯民族主義則公開挑戰英法在巴格達公約框架與中東基地體系上的安排。於是英法選擇了最危險也最有效的辦法：拉以色列先出兵，把一場外交與經濟衝突變成一場聯軍的地面戰爭。
causeEn: The causes run in three layers. The most immediate is sovereignty over the canal: on 26 July 1956 Nasser announced the nationalisation of the Suez Canal, dedicating the toll revenue to the Aswan dam. British and French shareholders together held more than ninety per cent of the company, which was nevertheless registered as an Egyptian company, so the act stripped Britain and France of nearly half their industrial assets on Egyptian soil, and opinion in the two countries boiled over immediately. A deeper layer is arms and aid: after the Western powers refused to sell Egypt modern weapons, the Egyptian military turned to Czechoslovakia and the Soviet Union to buy MiG-15s, MiG-17s and tanks, and Moscow agreed to supply them. The United States answered on 19 July by halting its offer of help in building the Aswan dam, and the European powers grew anxious that their whole military and administrative position in the Middle East was being nibbled away. The third layer is the strait and the sea lane: Egypt closed the Tiran straits, cutting off Israel's access to the Gulf of Aqaba through the Red Sea, which Israel regarded as a noose at its throat, while Nasser's pan-Arab nationalism openly challenged the Anglo-French arrangements built on the Baghdad Pact and the base system in the region. The answer chosen in London and Paris was the most dangerous and also the most effective: bring Israel in first and turn a diplomatic and economic confrontation into a ground war fought by a coalition.
impact: 影響的範圍遠超西奈半島。軍事上，埃及的第四裝甲師與第三步兵師等精銳部隊損失慘重，戰後花費數年才恢復戰力；以軍雖然一度佔領全境加沙與西奈，卻在一九五七年三月被迫全部退出，此後只能依賴停火線維持邊界。政治上，英國被指責為老牌殖民帝國的最後一次冒險，首相艾登在一九五七年一月辭職，繼任者麥克米倫加速非殖民化，英國就此失去超級大國地位，在中東的軍政網絡全面收縮；法國在戴高樂於一九五八年回任總統後轉向歐洲自主與獨立核能力，與美國的裂痕由此公開化。國際體系上，美國轉向以阿拉伯國家為對象的「艾森豪主義」，一九五七年一月國會撥款二十億美元用於對抗蘇聯在中東的擴張；蘇聯則藉助阿拉伯世界的勝利擴大在中東的影響，美蘇兩強格局自此定型，延續到一九七九年的伊朗革命。聯合國成立緊急部隊進駐以埃邊境，加拿大外長萊斯特·皮爾森因推動停火獲一九五七年諾貝爾和平獎；蘇伊士運河在封鎖數月後於一九五七年四月重開，埃及在軍事失利中保住了運河的國家所有權，阿拉伯民族主義的號召力也隨之大增。
impactEn: The consequences reached far beyond Sinai. Militarily, the Egyptian 4th Armoured Division and 3rd Infantry Division and other elite formations were badly mauled and needed years to recover their strength; the Israelis, having occupied Gaza and the whole of Sinai, were forced to give all of it back in March 1957 and thereafter held the frontier only along the armistice line. Politically, Britain was branded with the last gamble of a colonial empire, and Anthony Eden resigned in January 1957; his successor Macmillan accelerated decolonisation, and Britain lost its standing as a superpower, its military and administrative network in the Middle East contracting on every front. In France the affair pushed de Gaulle, back in the presidency from 1958, towards European autonomy and an independent nuclear capability, and the rift with Washington became public. At the level of the international system, the United States turned to the Arab states with the Eisenhower Doctrine, and in January 1957 Congress appropriated two billion dollars to hold the Middle East against Soviet expansion; the Soviet Union used the Arab victory to enlarge its own position, and the two-superpower pattern in the region was thereby set, holding until the Iranian revolution of 1979. The United Nations created an emergency force to police the Egyptian-Israeli border, and the Canadian foreign minister Lester Pearson received the 1957 Nobel Peace Prize for his part in brokering the ceasefire. The canal, blocked for several months, reopened in April 1957; Egypt, militarily defeated, kept the national ownership of the waterway, and the pull of Arab nationalism grew accordingly.
result: 結局是三方各有所得，也各有所失。以色列完成了作戰目標：十月二十九日至三十一日之間推進約二百六十公里，攻佔整個西奈與加沙，把埃軍主力逐出運河東岸；但英法停火一到，以軍最遲於一九五七年三月退出全部佔區，只留下加沙一條走廊。英法聯軍在技術上打贏了地面戰：十一月五日空降塞得港，六日進佔福阿德港，七日蘇伊士落入聯軍之手，埃及空軍在地面被重創，運河北段一度在聯軍控制之下；但聯軍無法阻止運河被沉船封鎖，無法把戰果延伸到埃軍縱深，更無法在美國斷油、蘇聯通牒與世界輿論三重壓力下維持佔領，十一月六日便接受停火，十二月下旬英軍全部撤出，一九五七年一月法軍亦告撤離，最終一寸運河也沒有留在英法手中。埃及在戰役層面是失敗者：運河控制權喪失，第四裝甲師建制崩解，首都與三角洲一度暴露在敵前；但納賽爾拒絕在主權與政權問題上讓步，換來的是政權的鞏固、國民對泛阿拉伯主義的認同，以及運河最終仍屬埃及的結果——運河在聯合國部隊監督下於一九五七年四月重新通航，而英法則把整個帝國的體面留在了這片沙漠裡。
resultEn: The outcome left all three parties with something gained and something lost. Israel achieved its operational aim: in the days between 29 and 31 October it advanced some two hundred and sixty kilometres, took the whole of Sinai and Gaza, and drove the bulk of the Egyptian army back to the east bank of the canal. But once the Anglo-French ceasefire came, the Israeli army was out of all its occupied territory by March 1957 at the latest, keeping only the Gaza corridor. The coalition won the ground war on technique: the airborne landing at Port Said on 5 November, Port Fouad taken on the 6th, Suez in coalition hands on the 7th, the Egyptian air force gutted on the ground, and the northern stretch of the canal briefly under foreign control. But the coalition could not stop the canal being blocked by scuttled ships, could not extend the results into the Egyptian rear areas, and could not hold what it had taken under the combined pressure of the American oil embargo, the Soviet ultimatum and world opinion; on 6 November it accepted a ceasefire, British troops were out by late December and the French followed in January 1957, and not a single inch of the canal stayed in Anglo-French hands. At the level of the campaign Egypt was the loser: control of the waterway was gone, the 4th Armoured Division was broken, and the capital and the Delta were briefly exposed. But Nasser refused to concede anything on sovereignty or on the regime itself, and in exchange kept his government, the adherence of his people to pan-Arab nationalism, and a canal that was still Egyptian; the waterway reopened under United Nations supervision in April 1957, while Britain and France left the whole of their imperial dignity out on that sand.
